description.value: Each time a mech gets this upgrade, it installs a new suite of sensing equipment that provides one of these benefits in a selected sense (electronics, heat, life, scent, sound, vibration, vision): blindsense 30 ft.; blindsight 30 ft. for an existing blindsense; sense through 30 ft. for an existing blindsight or vision; extend a blindsense by 60 ft.; extend a blindsight by 30 ft., up to the matching blindsense range; extend a sense through by 30 ft., up to blindsight range; unflankable; see invisibility (tier 5 or higher); true seeing to 120 ft. (tier 11 or higher).
